title: Dyeable Potent Sulfur
description: Adds dyeable potent sulfur blocks that change their geysir colors!
body:
# Dyeable Potent Sulfur
Dye the potent sulfur block to the color you want!

Now out for fabric snapshot 26.2 - Snapshot 5 (support will be added for neoforge when the version is released)
![Preview](https://github.com/sshcrack/dyed-sulfur-blocks/blob/main/imgs/preview.gif?raw=true)

Just combine a Potent Sulfur Block with a dye aand there you go!
